objective_for_doctor:
Age: 12
Sex: Male
Chief Complaint: I have a fever, burning pain, and right tonsil pain

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

Hi. I’ve had a fever and really bad throat pain—burning pain in my throat and pain in both tonsils, more on the right. I also have some pain in the roof of my mouth and my pharynx, and I’ve had nasal congestion with a clear runny nose.
[ASK] Does the patient have a barking cough with inspiratory stridor (croup-like breathing)?
No, I don’t have a barking cough or that kind of breathing sound.
[ASK] Do you have difficulty breathing or noisy breathing/stridor?
No, I don’t have trouble breathing or noisy breathing/stridor.
[ASK] Do you have a fever (≥38°C) and body aches?
Yes, I have a fever. I don’t know about body aches—I'm mostly having the throat and tonsil pain.
[ASK] Do you have nasal symptoms with facial pressure or nasal congestion/discharge (with or without reduced smell)?
Yes, I have nasal congestion and a clear runny nose. I don’t know about facial pressure or smell changes.
